purpose: Source-bound inventory of existing household water backup, reuse and leak-monitoring capabilities. Every source statement remains separate until model, revision, end-use, measurement basis and installation are matched.

unit_conversions.note: Converted values are arithmetic conversions of source-listed US gallons/day, not new test results.

comparators.product_scope: Municipal backup water storage product family; exact tank/pump SKU not yet frozen

missing_or_unresolved: exact tank SKU and usable volume
exact pump model and pump curve
measured fixture pressure and flow under matched demand
installed and lifecycle cost in the target South African market
measured outage continuity and restoration performance

comparators.comparison_claim_ceiling: Establishes an incumbent feature baseline only. No matched physical performance, service duration, cost or WaterLoop superiority is established.

missing_or_unresolved: exact SKU, pipe-size and installation configuration

comparators.market_variant: Current manufacturer product-page description; exact sale-market hardware revision not yet frozen

observations.capacity_semantics: Manufacturer describes 360 L/day as potential/cleaning capacity, dependent on user behaviour. This is not accepted end-use delivery, measured net mains displacement or the NSF listing value.
missing_or_unresolved: current product page states 280 kWh/year while the January 2026 H300 v2.1 data sheet states 220 kWh/year; no reconciliation is published in the sources inspected
exact hardware/firmware and local-market revision
end-use split and time profile supporting the 360 L/day value
actual qualified output at target fixture pressure/flow
energy boundary and operating modes included in each annual-energy figure
South African installation, certification, service, spares and price

claims.auxiliary_output_condition: pressurized before transfer to T3 when T3 is full

observations.capacity_semantics: This January 2026 manufacturer technical sheet gives 220 kWh/year, while the current H300 product page inspected on 2026-11-04 gives 280 kWh/year. Both are retained; the source set does not explain the difference. It also distinguishes the Standard inlet from the Premium washing-machine option and states an internet connection requirement.
missing_or_unresolved: written reconciliation with current product-page 280 kWh/year figure
whether all model variants and operating modes share the same energy profile
whether loss of internet disables only monitoring/support or any essential operation, local controls, diagnostics or recovery

comparators.comparison_claim_ceiling: Manufacturer-declared potential capacity and energy only; not independently measured delivery, net water saving, potable qualification or WaterLoop comparison.

comparators.source_revision: Recycle Ready Guide H300 Collection 2025, February 2025

observations.capacity_semantics: The guide describes cleaning capacity as dependent on user behaviour. Its Wi-Fi requirement is preserved as a connectivity dependency; the January 2026 datasheet more explicitly states that an internet connection is needed over Ethernet or internal Wi-Fi.
missing_or_unresolved: whether the 220 kWh/year value applies to the currently marketed H300 configuration and why the current product page states 280 kWh/year
which standby, treatment and pump modes are included
whether local control, fault handling, basic operation and safe recovery remain available when the internet service is unavailable

comparators.comparison_claim_ceiling: Historical manufacturer guide only; do not silently substitute these figures for the current product page or a certified capacity.

observations.conversion: 52.8 US gal/day × 3.785411784 L/US gal = approximately 199.9 L/day.
observations.semantics: This is the rated capacity and use-class value shown in the NSF listing. It is distinct from the manufacturer's 360 L/day potential/cleaning-capacity statement.
missing_or_unresolved: full certification report and rated-capacity definition
exact H300 versus H350 design/revision mapping
which specific reuse outlets are inside the certified claim scope
whether manufacturer 360 L/day and listed 52.8 GPD represent different test/claim bases

comparators.comparison_claim_ceiling: Third-party listing evidence for the exact Class R / Laundry & Bathing scope only. Not potable approval, not a new independent field measurement and not proof of a product defect.

observations.semantics: Manufacturer-declared nominal pump figures. They are not fixture-boundary flow/pressure under a matched plumbing network and demand trace.
missing_or_unresolved: pump curve and pressure/flow curve over the operating envelope
delivered pressure at simultaneous-use fixtures
head loss, pipe topology and lift-pump configuration effects
independent inspection of air-gap/backflow installation in the target South African installation
performance at simultaneous outlets and actual fixture boundaries

comparators.comparison_claim_ceiling: Technical-sheet pump values only; physical fixture service remains to be measured.

exact local-market model/revision and permitted output uses

comparators.comparison_claim_ceiling: Third-party listing scope only. Do not compare the H600 with H300 or WaterLoop without matching source, end-use class and measured functional units.

comparator_family: Hydraloop H300/H600 and other exact certified configurations

acquisition_gaps: exact South African SKUs and local-market installation quotes
local distributor/installer, warranty, service response and spare-part availability
matched physical bench data for fixture pressure/flow, actual end-use quality, power and rejection/purge
exact connectivity profile and local/offline functional boundary

claim_ceiling: This ledger preserves public manufacturer and third-party listing statements only. It does not establish local availability, installation suitability, physical performance, water savings, potable quality, compliance, affordability, product superiority or market demand.

connectivity_qualification_matrix.failure: WAN internet down; local router/LAN remain up
Wi-Fi disabled; Ethernet retained where supported
LAN/router/DNS unavailable while appliance power remains
network equipment power lost while appliance remains powered
complete appliance power interruption and restoration

connectivity_qualification_claim_ceiling: Challenges are proposed test cases, not findings about the current Hydraloop, JoJo or Moen products. Exact SKU, firmware, network topology and manufacturer-approved test conditions must be frozen. No safety interlock is bypassed.
